global_rules: No legacy path is removed or altered in V2.1-8U.
Legacy count/strength is not governed PDA potency.
Parallel legacy behavior may continue until a separately authorized migration stage.
Migration must not silently change score, rank, eligibility, exposure, or public response.

matrix.governed_equivalent: NONE; governed PDA carries identity set and coverage, not strength
matrix.migration_condition: future shadow implementation demonstrates governed input coverage and downstream policy explicitly replaces this dependency
matrix.prohibited_migration: strength -> PDA potency or identity count -> magnitude

matrix.migration_condition: separate versioned production policy defines non-potency downstream behavior and activation stage validates ranking deltas
matrix.prohibited_migration: derive numeric PDA magnitude or reuse legacy score as governed authority

matrix.governed_equivalent: identity overlap is derivable structurally across governed sets
matrix.migration_condition: future contract implementation validates identity-relation derivation across bounded and governed replay
matrix.prohibited_migration: treat caution tag as active identity evidence

matrix.governed_equivalent: partial structural overlap only; routine burden remains external context
matrix.migration_condition: only a later routine-policy integration stage may change behavior
matrix.prohibited_migration: move routine/user state into intrinsic PDA

matrix.migration_condition: future production policy integration explicitly defines conflict resolution and is activation-authorized
activation-specific stage explicitly integrates versioned production-consumption input and validates behavior deltas
matrix.prohibited_migration: direct mapping from shadow/PDA categorical state to exposure

required_pre_deprecation_evidence: shadow/dual-run implementation of the frozen 8U envelope
activation-specific CI measures intended deltas and rollback
